characters.name: Rabbit
characters.greet: I made the compass myself. Never once lost.

characters.name: Toadstool
characters.greet: My aunt made it, long before the path.

characters.name: Owl
characters.greet: My sister made it. She has the finest hand.

characters.name: Magpie
characters.greet: My cousin made it. Clever bird, my cousin.

characters.name: Snail
characters.greet: I made it. Slow, but sure.

characters.name: Lantern Keeper
characters.greet: I made the lamp for the pines.

characters.name: Cat
characters.greet: Grandma made it. The kettle's on.

skills.name: Cottage Finder
skills.promise: This compass will help you find Grandma.

realWorld.note: Your note is your data. A skill can do its job and still copy that data to someone you never chose.

take: Reads Grandma's address from your note.
Points you to her door.

good.reveal: Found her door from your note.

take: Sends a copy of your note to a stranger.
Points you to her door.

bad.reveal: Found her door. A copy went to the wolf.

skills.name: Way Teller
skills.promise: I take you to her door, the old way.

realWorld.note: An agent that obeys text it reads on the way, like a note on a tree, lets whoever wrote it take charge.

take: Walks you the old way to her door.
Keeps to the path it knows.
Walks you the old way to her door.
Follows any note pinned to a tree.

bad.reveal: Walked you the old way. Obeyed the wolf's note too.

skills.name: Word Weaver
skills.promise: It sends word ahead, so Grandma expects you.

realWorld.note: A copy left at a crossing is data anyone passing can read. Reaching the right person does not undo the copies left behind.

take: Carries your note to Grandma, folded shut.
Gets there before you do.

good.reveal: Sent word ahead. She expected you.

take: Carries your note to Grandma, folded shut.
Pins a copy up at every crossing.

bad.reveal: She expected you. So did the wolf.

skills.name: Short Cut
skills.promise: It gives you the quicker tracks, fresh each evening.

realWorld.note: A map fetched from a stranger can be redrawn any night. A skill that loads instructions at run time can change after you approved it.

take: Draws tonight's tracks from its own map.
Shows you the quicker way.

good.reveal: A quicker way. You made good time.

take: Fetches tonight's tracks from a stranger's map.
Shows you the quicker way.

bad.reveal: A quicker way. The wolf drew it.

skills.name: Slow Post
skills.promise: I carry the heavy things, sealed. You walk light.

realWorld.note: A friend who peeks is a third party you never agreed to. A skill can deliver your data and share it along the way.

take: Carries your parcel, sealed.
Opens for Grandma's hands only.

good.reveal: You walked light. It reached her, sealed.

take: Carries your parcel, sealed.
Lets a friend peek inside on the way.

bad.reveal: It reached her. The wolf looked first.

skills.name: Night Light
skills.promise: It shows you what the signs say.

realWorld.note: Reading the signs helps you decide. Acting on them without asking you skips the human approval that important actions need.

take: Reads every sign aloud to you.
Leaves the choosing to you.
Reads every sign aloud to you.
Does what the signs say without asking you.

bad.reveal: One sign was the wolf's. It obeyed.

skills.name: Latch Lifter
skills.promise: I open Grandma's door. I feel where it sticks.

realWorld.note: A latch that lifts for anyone never checks who asks. A skill is an identity too: give it only the access its job needs.

take: Lifts her latch when you knock.
Locks it again behind you.
Lifts her latch for anyone who knocks.
Locks it again behind you.

bad.reveal: The wolf knocked first. It opened.

grandma.title: Clean arrival
lines: The door opens. Grandma waves from her chair.
Somewhere behind the trees, the wolf sighs.

wolf.title: That's not Grandma
lines: The chair by the fire is taken, and not by Grandma.
Every skill you took kept its promise. Not every one stopped there.

late.title: After dark
lines: You found the door long after dark.

howTo.title: How to play
steps: Walk the path and meet each character.
Open each card and read what the skill does.
Take the skill or leave it.
You have 3:00 to reach Grandma's door.

reveal.title: What each skill really did
reveal.giveaway: The line that gave it away
reveal.caught: You kept {caught} of {bad} bad skills out of your basket.
reveal.question: Who wrote the instructions your agent follows?
